Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Last updated: January 2026

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Your privacy matters to us — this policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

We’ve written this in plain language because we believe you shouldn’t need a law degree to understand how your data is handled.

1. Who We Are

  • Legal Entity: FKG Trading LLC
  • Website: dresslikemommy.com
  • Address: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC is the data controller for all personal information collected through this website.

2. Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

When you shop with us, create an account, or get in touch, you may provide:

  • Contact information — name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Payment information — credit/debit card details (processed securely by Shopify Payments; we never see or store your full card number)
  • Account credentials — email and password if you create an account
  • Communications — messages you send us via email, contact forms, or social media
  • Order details — products purchased, sizes, quantities

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our site, certain information is collected automatically:

  • Device and browser information — browser type, operating system, screen resolution, device type
  • IP address and approximate location (city/region level)
  • Browsing activity — pages visited, products viewed, time spent on pages, referring website
  • Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 5)

Information from Third Parties

We may receive limited information from:

  • Shopify — our e-commerce platform
  • Payment processors — transaction confirmation and fraud prevention
  • Marketing platforms — if you interact with our ads

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and receipts
  • Respond to your questions and support requests
  • Improve our website, products, and shopping experience
  • Send marketing emails (only with your consent)
  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Personalize your shopping experience

We will never sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Third-Party Services

  • Shopify — powers our online store and processes orders
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — PCI-DSS compliant payment processing
  • Email marketing — newsletter delivery; unsubscribe anytime
  • Shipping carriers — deliver your order and provide tracking
  • Google Analytics — aggregated site usage data

We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

5. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to keep your cart active, remember preferences, understand traffic, and support marketing (with consent). Control cookies via your browser settings.

6. Children’s Privacy

Dress Like Mommy sells children’s clothing, but our website is not directed at children. All purchases must be made by an adult (18+). We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16 (or 13 in the US).

7. Data Retention

  • Order records — 7 years for tax/accounting
  • Account info — while active; deleted on request
  • Marketing consent — until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics — anonymized within 26 months
  • Support comms — up to 3 years after resolution

8. Your Rights

All customers can access, correct, unsubscribe from marketing, and request deletion of their data.

GDPR (EEA/UK/Switzerland): Data portability, restrict/object to processing, withdraw consent, lodge complaints.

CCPA (California): Know what we collect, delete data, opt out of sales. We do not sell your data.

Contact: info@dresslikemommy.com. Response within 30 days.

9. Data Security

SSL/TLS encryption, PCI-DSS payment processing, access controls. No method is 100% secure.

10. International Transfers

Shopify servers may be outside your country. EEA/UK/Swiss transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses.

11. Changes

We update the “Last Updated” date for significant changes.

12. Contact Us

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

آخر تحديث: 28 يناير 2026

تتم إدارة

Dress Like Mommy بواسطة شركة FKG Trading LLC، وهي شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة في فلوريدا. خصوصيتك تهمنا — توضح هذه السياسة المعلومات التي نجمعها، وكيفية استخدامها، وحقوقك.

لقد كتبنا هذا بلغة واضحة لأننا نعتقد أنك لا تحتاج إلى شهادة في القانون لفهم كيفية التعامل مع بياناتك.

1. من نحن

  • الكيان القانوني: FKG Trading LLC
  • موقع الويب: dresslikemommy.com
  • العنوان: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr، نابولي، فلوريدا 34119، الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية
  • البريد الإلكتروني: info@__DLMTOK1__
  • الهاتف: (786) 309-6006

إن شركة FKG Trading LLC هي المتحكم في البيانات لجميع المعلومات الشخصية التي يتم جمعها من خلال هذا الموقع.

2. المعلومات التي نجمعها

المعلومات التي تقدمها مباشرة

عندما تتسوق معنا، أو تنشئ حسابًا، أو تتواصل معنا، يمكنك تقديم ما يلي:

  • معلومات الاتصال — الاسم وعنوان البريد الإلكتروني ورقم الهاتف
  • عناوين الشحن والفوترة
  • معلومات الدفع - تفاصيل بطاقة الائتمان/الخصم (تتم معالجتها بشكل آمن بواسطة Shopify Payments؛ ولا نرى رقم بطاقتك بالكامل أو نخزنه مطلقًا)
  • بيانات اعتماد الحساب — البريد الإلكتروني وكلمة المرور إذا قمت بإنشاء حساب
  • الاتصالات — الرسائل التي ترسلها إلينا عبر البريد الإلكتروني أو نماذج الاتصال أو وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي
  • تفاصيل الطلب — المنتجات المشتراة والأحجام والكميات

المعلومات التي يتم جمعها تلقائيًا

عندما تزور موقعنا، يتم جمع معلومات معينة تلقائيًا:

  • معلومات الجهاز والمتصفح — نوع المتصفح ونظام التشغيل ودقة الشاشة ونوع الجهاز
  • عنوان IP والموقع التقريبي (مستوى المدينة/المنطقة)
  • نشاط التصفح — الصفحات التي تمت زيارتها، والمنتجات التي تم عرضها، والوقت المستغرق في الصفحات، وموقع الويب المرجعي
  • ملفات تعريف الارتباط والتقنيات المشابهة (راجع القسم 5)

معلومات من أطراف ثالثة

قد نتلقى معلومات محدودة من:

  • Shopify — منصتنا للتجارة الإلكترونية
  • معالجو الدفع — تأكيد المعاملة ومنع الاحتيال
  • منصات التسويق — إذا كنت تتفاعل مع إعلاناتنا

3. كيف نستخدم معلوماتك

  • معالجة طلباتك وتنفيذها
  • أرسل تأكيدات الطلب وتحديثات الشحن والإيصالات
  • الرد على أسئلتك وطلبات الدعم
  • تحسين موقعنا الإلكتروني ومنتجاتنا وتجربة التسوق
  • أرسل رسائل بريد إلكتروني تسويقية (فقط بموافقتك)
  • اكتشاف الاحتيال ومنعه
  • الامتثال للالتزامات القانونية
  • إضفاء طابع شخصي على تجربة التسوق الخاصة بك

لن نقوم أبدًا ببيع معلوماتك الشخصية إلى أطراف ثالثة.

4. خدمات الطرف الثالث

  • Shopify — يدعم متجرنا عبر الإنترنت ويعالج الطلبات
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — معالجة الدفع المتوافقة مع PCI-DSS
  • التسويق عبر البريد الإلكتروني — تسليم الرسائل الإخبارية؛ إلغاء الاشتراك في أي وقت
  • شركات الشحن — تسليم طلبك وتوفير التتبع
  • Google Analytics — بيانات استخدام الموقع المجمعة

نحن لا نشارك معلوماتك مع أطراف ثالثة لأغراض تسويقية خاصة بهم.

5. ملفات تعريف الارتباط والتتبع

نحن نستخدم ملفات تعريف الارتباط للحفاظ على سلة التسوق الخاصة بك نشطة، وتذكر التفضيلات، وفهم حركة المرور، ودعم التسويق (بموافقة). التحكم في ملفات تعريف الارتباط عبر إعدادات المتصفح الخاص بك.

6. خصوصية الأطفال

تبيع شركة Dress Like Mommy ملابس الأطفال، لكن موقعنا الإلكتروني غير موجه للأطفال. يجب أن تتم جميع عمليات الشراء بواسطة شخص بالغ (18+). نحن لا نجمع معلومات عن عمد من أي شخص يقل عمره عن 16 عامًا (أو 13 عامًا في الولايات المتحدة).

7. الاحتفاظ بالبيانات

  • سجلات الطلبات — 7 سنوات للضرائب/المحاسبة
  • معلومات الحساب — أثناء النشاط؛ تم حذفه عند الطلب
  • موافقة التسويق — حتى تقوم بإلغاء الاشتراك
  • التحليلات — مجهولة المصدر خلال 26 شهرًا
  • اتصالات الدعم — لمدة تصل إلى 3 سنوات بعد الحل

8. حقوقك

يمكن لجميع العملاء الوصول إلى بياناتهم وتصحيحها وإلغاء الاشتراك فيها وطلب حذفها.

اللائحة العامة لحماية البيانات (المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية/المملكة المتحدة/سويسرا): إمكانية نقل البيانات، وتقييد/الاعتراض على المعالجة، وسحب الموافقة، وتقديم الشكاوى.

CCPA (كاليفورنيا): تعرف على ما نقوم بجمعه، وحذف البيانات، وإلغاء الاشتراك في المبيعات. نحن لا نبيع بياناتك.

جهة الاتصال: info@__DLMTOK2__. الرد خلال 30 يومًا.

9. أمن البيانات

تشفير SSL/TLS ومعالجة الدفع PCI-DSS والتحكم في الوصول. لا توجد طريقة آمنة بنسبة 100%.

10. التحويلات الدولية

قد تكون خوادم Shopify خارج بلدك. تستخدم التحويلات في المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية/المملكة المتحدة/سويسرا الشروط التعاقدية القياسية.

11. التغييرات

نقوم بتحديث تاريخ "آخر تحديث" لإجراء تغييرات مهمة.

12. اتصل بنا

  • البريد الإلكتروني: info@__DLMTOK3__
  • الهاتف: (786) 309-6006
  • البريد: FKG Trading LLC، 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr، نابولي، فلوريدا 34119، الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية

سياسة الخصوصية المقدمة من FKG Trading LLC، مشغل Dress Like Mommy.

Shipping Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

At Dress Like Mommy, we want your matching outfits to arrive as clearly and reliably as possible. Review the shipping method, rate, and delivery estimate shown at checkout before placing an order.

Where We Ship

Shipping is available to the countries and regions shown at checkout. Availability depends on the destination, product, and shipping methods shown during checkout. Use the country/region selector or the checkout shipping step to confirm whether we can ship to your address before placing an order.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown for your address, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Shipping Rates

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

You will receive an email with tracking information once your order ships.

Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout.

  • Standard Delivery: the current checkout estimate displays before payment.
  • Express Delivery: available for some destinations where shown at checkout.

These are estimates. Actual delivery times may vary because of customs processing, carrier delays, weather, holidays, or local conditions.

How Our Shipping Works

  1. Order Placed: you receive an order confirmation email.
  2. Order Processing: your order is prepared after payment confirmation.
  3. Shipped: tracking information is emailed when available.
  4. In Transit: use the tracking link for carrier updates.
  5. Delivered: your package is delivered to the address provided at checkout.

Order Tracking

Every order includes a tracking number when the carrier provides one. Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the number is issued.

You can also check your order status anytime by visiting our Order Status page.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders shipped outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These charges are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping Problems

If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and tracking information. We will help review the carrier information and next available steps.

Contact Us

For shipping questions, email info@dresslikemommy.com.

These are estimates. Actual delivery times may vary because of customs processing, carrier delays, weather, holidays, or local conditions.

How Our Shipping Works

  1. Order Placed: you receive an order confirmation email.
  2. Order Processing: your order is prepared after payment confirmation.
  3. Shipped: tracking information is emailed when available.
  4. In Transit: use the tracking link for carrier updates.
  5. Delivered: your package is delivered to the address provided at checkout.

Order Tracking

Every order includes a tracking number when the carrier provides one. Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the number is issued.

You can also check your order status anytime by visiting our Order Status page.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders shipped outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These charges are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping Problems

If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and tracking information. We will help review the carrier information and next available steps.

Contact Us

For shipping questions, email info@dresslikemommy.com.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

قصتنا

حيث يلتقي أزياء العائلة بالاتصال الحقيقي

تأسست Dress Like Mommy من فكرة بسيطة: العائلات التي ترتدي ملابس متطابقة تتقارب معًا.

تأسست في عام 2016 على يد فرانسيسكو، أب لطفلتين في نابولي، فلوريدا، بدأت Dress Like Mommy عندما لاحظ كيف تضيء بناته في كل مرة يرتدين فيها ملابس متطابقة مع والدتهن. تلك الشرارة من الفرح — الضحكات، الصور، لحظات "نحن متطابقون!" — أصبحت جوهر عمل مكرس لجمع العائلات معًا من خلال الأزياء.

ماذا نفعل

نقوم بتنسيق ملابس متطابقة للأمهات والآباء والأطفال — من بيجامات العطلات الدافئة إلى مجموعات الكاجوال اليومية والإطلالات الخاصة بالمناسبات. يتم اختيار كل قطعة مع مراعاة الراحة، والأناقة، والأسعار المعقولة، حتى تتمكن العائلات في كل مكان من خلق تلك اللحظات المثالية دون إنفاق مبالغ كبيرة.

عملاؤنا

منذ عام 2016، خدمنا آلاف العائلات في الولايات المتحدة، كندا، المملكة المتحدة، وأستراليا. سواء كانت بيجامات متطابقة في صباح عيد الميلاد، جلسة تصوير عائلية، أو مجرد يوم ممتع بالخروج بملابس متطابقة مع نسخة مصغرة منك، يواصل عملاؤنا العودة من أجل الابتسامات التي تخلقها هذه الملابس.

الجودة والعناية

تمر كل قطعة في مجموعتنا بعملية اختيار دقيقة. نتعاون مع مصنعين موثوقين لنقدم أحدث أنماط الملابس العائلية المتطابقة بأسعار عادلة. إذا كان هناك أي خطأ في طلبك، فإن فريق خدمة العملاء لدينا هنا لتصحيحه.

لماذا تتسوق معنا؟

  • شركة عائلية — يديرها أب حقيقي يفهم الأمر
  • شحن مجاني على جميع الطلبات

  • دفع آمن — معلومات الدفع الخاصة بك محمية دائمًا

تواصل معنا

نحب رؤية العائلات ترتدي ملابس متطابقة! ضع علامة علينا على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي باستخدام #DressLikeMommy وشارك لحظاتك.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

translations.value:
سياسة الإرجاع وإلغاء الطلب

في Dress Like Mommy، نلتزم بضمان رضاك التام عن كل عملية شراء. يرجى مراجعة سياسات الإرجاع وإلغاء الطلب أدناه. إذا كان لديك أي أسئلة أو تحتاج إلى مساعدة إضافية، لا تتردد في التواصل معنا على info@dresslikemommy.com.

1. الإرجاع

أهلية الإرجاع

  • الإطار الزمني: يتم قبول الإرجاع خلال 30 يومًا من تاريخ الشراء.
  • الحالة: يجب إرجاع المنتجات في حالتها الأصلية، غير مرتدية، غير مغسولة، ومع جميع العلامات المرفقة.
  • التغليف: يجب أن يكون التغليف الأصلي سليمًا وجميع المحتويات الأصلية متضمنة.

الإرجاع غير المؤهل

  • المنتجات التي تكون تالفة، مستخدمة، معدلة، أو ناقصة أجزاء.
  • الإرجاع بدون معلومات الطلب الأصلية داخل الطرد.

شحن الإرجاع

  • المسؤولية: يتحمل المشترون جميع تكاليف شحن الإرجاع.
  • التوصية: استخدم طريقة شحن آمنة أو قابلة للتتبع واحتفظ بإثبات الإرسال.

المبالغ المستردة

  • المبالغ المستردة الكاملة: تُصدر للمنتجات المُعادة بحالتها الأصلية وتغليفها الأصلي.
  • المبالغ المستردة الجزئية: قد تُخصم إذا كانت المنتجات المُعادة تالفة أو مستخدمة أو غير مكتملة لتغطية أي خسارة في القيمة.
  • مدة المعالجة: عادةً ما تتم معالجة المبالغ المستردة خلال 4-6 أسابيع من استلام الطرد المُعاد. غالباً ما تتم المعالجة بشكل أسرع.
  • التحقق: لا يتم إصدار المبالغ المستردة حتى نستلم المنتجات المُعادة أو إثبات شحن صالح (مثل إيصال ممسوح ضوئياً مع التاريخ والوقت ورقم التتبع).

2. إلغاء الطلب

سياسة الإلغاء

  • الأهلية: يمكن إلغاء الطلبات خلال 12 ساعة عمل من الدفع.
  • الإجراء: لإلغاء طلب، يرجى التواصل معنا فوراً على info@dresslikemommy.com خلال الإطار الزمني المحدد.
  • بعد الشحن: بمجرد تعبئة الطلب وشحنه، لا يمكن إلغاؤه.

3. كيفية إرجاع أو استبدال منتج

عملية الإرجاع للمنتجات غير المناسبة أو غير المرغوب فيها

  1. اتصل بنا: أرسل بريدًا إلكترونيًا إلى info@dresslikemommy.com لبدء عملية الإرجاع خلال 30 يومًا من الشراء.
  2. تحضير الطرد: أعد تغليف المنتج في عبوته الأصلية، مع التأكد من إرفاق جميع الملصقات والبطاقات.
  3. شحن المنتج: أرسل الطرد إلى عنوان الإرجاع المقدم باستخدام طريقة شحن آمنة أو قابلة للتتبع. نوصي باستخدام مكتب البريد المحلي لتقليل التكاليف. احتفظ بإثبات الشحن الخاص بك.
  4. التأكيد: بمجرد استلامنا للإرجاع، سنقوم بمعالجة استرداد المبلغ أو الاستبدال وسنخطرك عبر البريد الإلكتروني.

سياسة الاستبدال

  • الاستبدالات المؤهلة: يمكن استبدال الأحجام والألوان فقط لنفس المنتج.
  • نماذج مختلفة: لاستبدال المنتج بنموذج مختلف، يرجى إرجاع المنتج الأصلي وتقديم طلب جديد للمنتج المطلوب.

4. إرجاع المنتجات المعطوبة

إذا استلمت منتجًا معطوبًا، يرجى اتباع الخطوات التالية:

  1. اتصل بالدعم: أرسل بريدًا إلكترونيًا إلى info@dresslikemommy.com مع المعلومات التالية:
    • رقم الطلب
    • اسمك وعنوانك
    • تفاصيل المنتج (الكمية، رمز SKU)
    • وصف المشكلة
  2. إرفاق الأدلة: أرفق صورة واضحة للمنتج المعطوب في بريدك الإلكتروني.
  3. تعليمات الإرجاع: سيزودك فريق الدعم بتعليمات حول كيفية إرجاع المنتج المعطوب لاسترداد المبلغ أو استبداله.

5. معلومات إضافية

  • تشمل المعالجة: فترة الاسترداد تشمل وقت النقل، ومعالجة الإرجاع، ومعالجة الاسترداد.
  • اتصل بنا: لأي استفسارات أو مساعدة بخصوص الإرجاع والإلغاء، يرجى التواصل معنا على info@dresslikemommy.com.

6. العناصر غير القابلة للإرجاع

  • المنتجات المخصصة أو المفصلة حسب الطلب
  • الملابس الداخلية
  • بطاقات الهدايا

7. حقوق العملاء

إذا كنت من سكان الاتحاد الأوروبي، لديك الحق في إرجاع مشترياتك خلال 14 يومًا دون الحاجة إلى إبداء أي سبب. لمزيد من المعلومات، يرجى التواصل مع فريق الدعم الخاص بنا.

شكرًا لتسوقك مع Dress Like Mommy. نحن نقدر ثقتك ونسعى لتقديم أفضل تجربة تسوق ممكنة لك.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

معلومات عنا

أ. أسئلة عامة

1. هل هذا الموقع آمن للاستخدام؟

بالتأكيد هو آمن. نستخدم PayPal لمعالجة المدفوعات. لذلك حتى موظفونا لا يرون تفاصيل الدفع الخاصة بك. PayPal هو أكبر مزود دفع آمن في العالم. موقعنا مبني على منصة Shopify الآمنة. جميع معلوماتك الشخصية محمية بشكل محكم.

 

2. كم بسرعة تردون على استفسارات البريد الإلكتروني؟

نرد على جميع الرسائل الإلكترونية خلال يوم عمل واحد.

 

3. أين مقر شركتكم؟

تتم عملياتنا الرئيسية في الاتحاد الأوروبي مع مركز الدعم في ليتوانيا والمصنعين والمخازن في شرق آسيا.

 

4. لماذا أسعاركم رخيصة جدًا؟

نقطع جميع الوسطاء ونوصل المنتجات مباشرة إلى المستهلكين من المصنعين لدينا مما يسمح لنا بتقديم أسعار منخفضة جدًا.

قبل تقديم الطلب

أ. المقاسات

1. أين يمكنني العثور على جدول المقاسات بالسنتيمترات؟

استخدم جدول المقاسات الخاص بالمنتج والمقاس الذي تفكر في اختياره. تحقق من وحدات القياس وما إذا كان الجدول يعرض قياسات الجسم أم قياسات قطعة الملابس. يوضح دليل المقاسات كيفية أخذ القياسات ومقارنة المقاسات. إذا كان الجدول أو أحد القياسات غير واضح، فتواصل معنا قبل الطلب.

 

2. هل سأستلم منتجًا بمقاس أكبر بمقدار مقاسين؟

تختلف تسميات المقاسات والقياسات باختلاف المنتج والشركة المصنّعة. اختر كل قطعة بالاعتماد على جدول مقاساتها والخيارات المتاحة، بدلاً من افتراض أن المقاس بالحروف الذي ترتديه عادةً مناسب أو تطبيق تحويل ثابت بين المقاسات. إذا لم تكن متأكداً، فتواصل معنا قبل الطلب.

ب. المدفوعات

1. ما أنواع المدفوعات التي تقبلونها؟

نقبل PayPal وبطاقات الائتمان/الخصم (Visa، Mastercard، American Express، Discover).

 

2. أريد الدفع ببطاقتي الائتمانية، لكن يتم توجيهي إلى صفحة PayPal؟

نستخدم PayPal لمعالجة جميع مدفوعاتنا. في صفحة PayPal على اليمين يمكنك اختيار أحد الخيارين: "الدفع بحساب PayPal الخاص بي" أو "الدفع ببطاقتي الائتمانية أو الخصم"

ج. الشحن

1. ما هو سعر الشحن؟

نقدم توصيلًا مجانيًا تمامًا في جميع أنحاء العالم.

 

2. هل توصلون إلى بلدي؟

نعم، نحن نوصل إلى جميع دول العالم.

 

3. كم من الوقت سيستغرق وصول طلبي؟

عادةً ما تستغرق عملية التوصيل حوالي 15-30 يومًا. ومع ذلك، يمكنك التحقق من تقديرات التوصيل الدقيقة هنا: صفحة الشحن

 

4. هل أحتاج لدفع أي رسوم جمركية؟

لا، لست بحاجة لدفع رسوم الجمارك. نحن نضع علامة على جميع طلباتنا كهدايا منخفضة القيمة. علاوة على ذلك، نرسل الطلبات الأكبر في طرود منفصلة.

بعد تقديم الطلب

أ. حالة الطلب

1. ماذا يعني: حالة الطلب "غير منفذ"؟

يتم الآن معالجة طلبك ورقم تتبع الطلب قيد الانتظار. عادةً ما نقوم بتنفيذ الطلبات وإرسال رقم التتبع لعملائنا عندما يتم تقديم رقم تتبع الطلب إلى النظام البريدي، والذي يستغرق من 5 إلى 7 أيام بعد شحن الطلب.

 

2. ماذا يعني: حالة الطلب "تم التنفيذ"؟

هذا يعني أن طلبك قيد الشحن.

 

3. مر وقت طويل، أين طلبي؟

يرجى التحقق من تتبع طلبك لمزيد من المعلومات. إذا استمرت المشكلة، يرجى مراسلتنا عبر البريد الإلكتروني: support@dresslikemommy.com

ب. تتبع الطلب

1. كيف أتتبع طلبي؟

نوفر رمز تتبع الطلب بعد 5-7 أيام من تقديم الطلب. يمكنك تتبع طلبك هنا: تتبع طلبك

 

2. رمز التتبع الخاص بي يقول "قيد الانتظار" أو "لا توجد معلومات متاحة في الوقت الحالي".

أحيانًا تظهر نتائج التتبع الأولى بعد 5-10 أيام عمل من استلامك لرقم تتبع الطلب. إذا استمرت المشكلة لأكثر من 10 أيام عمل، يرجى الاتصال بنا: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. رمز التتبع الخاص بي يقول "منتهي الصلاحية"

يرجى الاتصال بنا: support@dresslikemommy.com وسنقوم بحل هذه المشكلة بسرعة.

 

4. كيف أبقى على اطلاع بتتبع طلبي؟

نستخدم نظام تتبع After Ship لتتبع طلبات عملائنا، لذا كلما تم تحديث معلومات التتبع، يجب أن تتلقى بريدًا إلكترونيًا.

ب. أريد تغيير أو إلغاء طلبي

1. طلبت شيئًا، لكنني أريد الإلغاء

يجب عليك الاتصال بنا خلال يوم عمل واحد من تقديم الطلب لترتيب تغيير الطلب. يمكنك القيام بذلك عبر البريد الإلكتروني support@dresslikemommy.com مع رقم طلبك كموضوع.

 

2. طلبت شيئًا، لكن أريد تغيير لون المنتج أو مقاسه.

يجب عليك الاتصال بنا خلال يوم عمل واحد من تقديم الطلب لترتيب تغيير الطلب. يمكنك القيام بذلك عبر البريد الإلكتروني support@dresslikemommy.com مع خيار اللون أو المقاس الجديد الخاص بك.

 

3. طلبت شيئًا، لكن أريد تغيير عنوان التوصيل

يجب عليك الاتصال بنا خلال يوم عمل واحد من تقديم الطلب لترتيب تغيير الطلب. يمكنك القيام بذلك عبر البريد الإلكتروني support@dresslikemommy.com مع عنوان التوصيل الجديد الخاص بك.

بعد استلامك للطلب

أ. أريد تغيير أو إرجاع طلبي

1. وصل طلبي، لكن المنتجات كانت بمقاسين أكبر

قد تختلف تسميات المقاسات. إذا بدا أن المقاس أو القياسات لا تتوافق مع طلبك، فتواصل مع support@dresslikemommy.com وأرسل رقم طلبك والتفاصيل. راجع سياسة الاسترداد الحالية قبل إعادة أي قطعة.

 

2. وصل طلبي، لكنني استلمت المنتجات الخاطئة

يرجى الاتصال بنا على support@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. إذا كان الخطأ من جانبنا، يمكنك إعادة المنتجات وسنرسل لك المنتجات الصحيحة على حسابنا (أو نصدر استردادًا).

 

3. وصل طلبي وأريد تغيير المقاس/اللون

يرجى الاتصال بنا على support@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. يمكنك إعادة المنتج إلينا وسنرسل لك منتجًا جديدًا بالمقاس المحدث. *تكاليف الشحن ستكون على حسابك.

 

4. وصل طلبي، لكنني أريد إرجاعه.

يرجى الاتصال بنا على support@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. يمكنك إعادة المنتج إلينا وسنقوم بإصدار استرداد. *تكاليف الشحن ستكون على حسابك.

Shipping Information

At Dress Like Mommy, we are an online store that ships matching family outfits to destinations available at checkout through our shipping and fulfillment partners. Here is how to confirm shipping, delivery timing, and tracking before you place an order.

Standard And Express Shipping Options

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Where We Ship

Shipping availability is based on the country/region and address entered at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can ship there under the displayed method and rate.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown, email us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Processing And Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout. Review the shipping method and estimate shown during checkout before placing your order.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, check your email for tracking information. You can also visit your account or use the tracking link in the shipping confirmation email when available.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping FAQ

Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
Contact us as soon as possible at info@dresslikemommy.com. If your order has not moved into fulfillment yet, we can review whether an address change is still possible.

Do you ship to P.O. Boxes?
Shipping availability for P.O. Boxes depends on the destination and carrier options shown at checkout.

My package has not arrived yet.
Check your tracking link first. If the tracking has not updated for several business days or the delivery estimate has passed, email us with your order number.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Your privacy matters to us — this policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

We’ve written this in plain language because we believe you shouldn’t need a law degree to understand how your data is handled.

1. Who We Are

  • Legal Entity: FKG Trading LLC
  • Website: dresslikemommy.com
  • Address: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC is the data controller for all personal information collected through this website.

2. Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

When you shop with us, create an account, or get in touch, you may provide:

  • Contact information — name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Payment information — credit/debit card details (processed securely by Shopify Payments; we never see or store your full card number)
  • Account credentials — email and password if you create an account
  • Communications — messages you send us via email, contact forms, or social media
  • Order details — products purchased, sizes, quantities

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our site, certain information is collected automatically:

  • Device and browser information — browser type, operating system, screen resolution, device type
  • IP address and approximate location (city/region level)
  • Browsing activity — pages visited, products viewed, time spent on pages, referring website
  • Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 5)

Information from Third Parties

We may receive limited information from:

  • Shopify — our e-commerce platform
  • Payment processors — transaction confirmation and fraud prevention
  • Marketing platforms — if you interact with our ads

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and receipts
  • Respond to your questions and support requests
  • Improve our website, products, and shopping experience
  • Send marketing emails (only with your consent)
  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Personalize your shopping experience

We will never sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Third-Party Services

  • Shopify — powers our online store and processes orders
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — PCI-DSS compliant payment processing
  • Email marketing — newsletter delivery; unsubscribe anytime
  • Shipping carriers — deliver your order and provide tracking
  • Google Analytics — aggregated site usage data

We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

5. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to keep your cart active, remember preferences, understand traffic, and support marketing (with consent). Control cookies via your browser settings.

6. Children’s Privacy

Dress Like Mommy sells children’s clothing, but our website is not directed at children. All purchases must be made by an adult (18+). We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16 (or 13 in the US).

7. Data Retention

  • Order records — 7 years for tax/accounting
  • Account info — while active; deleted on request
  • Marketing consent — until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics — anonymized within 26 months
  • Support comms — up to 3 years after resolution

8. Your Rights

All customers can access, correct, unsubscribe from marketing, and request deletion of their data.

GDPR (EEA/UK/Switzerland): Data portability, restrict/object to processing, withdraw consent, lodge complaints.

CCPA (California): Know what we collect, delete data, opt out of sales. We do not sell your data.

Contact: info@dresslikemommy.com. Response within 30 days.

9. Data Security

SSL/TLS encryption, PCI-DSS payment processing, access controls. No method is 100% secure.

10. International Transfers

Shopify servers may be outside your country. EEA/UK/Swiss transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses.

11. Changes

We update the “Last Updated” date for significant changes.

12. Contact Us

  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy

Connect With Us

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

translations.value:
Náš příběh

Kde se rodinná móda setkává s opravdovým spojením

Dress Like Mommy vzniklo z jednoduché myšlenky: rodiny, které se sladí, se také více sblíží.

Společnost založil v roce 2016 Francisco, otec dvou dívek z Neapole na Floridě, když si všiml, jak jeho dcery září pokaždé, když měly sladěné oblečení s maminkou. Ten záblesk radosti — smích, fotky, momenty „jsme dvojčata!“ — se stal srdcem podnikání, které se věnuje sbližování rodin prostřednictvím módy.

Co děláme

Vybíráme sladěné outfity pro maminky, tatínky a děti — od pohodlných vánočních pyžam až po každodenní ležérní sety a oblečení na speciální příležitosti. Každý kousek je vybrán s ohledem na pohodlí, styl a dostupnost, aby si rodiny po celém světě mohly vytvořit ty dokonalé okamžiky bez zbytečných výdajů.

Naši zákazníci

Od roku 2016 jsme obsloužili tisíce rodin v USA, Kanadě, Velké Británii a Austrálii. Ať už jde o vánoční sladěná pyžama, rodinné focení nebo jen zábavný den ve stejném oblečení s vaším mini já, naši zákazníci se k nám stále vracejí pro úsměvy, které tyto outfity přinášejí.

Kvalita a péče

Každý produkt v naší kolekci prochází pečlivým výběrem. Spolupracujeme s důvěryhodnými výrobci, abychom nabízeli nejnovější rodinné sladěné styly za férové ceny. Pokud s vaší objednávkou něco není v pořádku, náš zákaznický servis je tu, aby to napravil.

Proč nakupovat u nás?

  • Rodinný podnik — vedený opravdovým tátou, který tomu rozumí
  • Doprava zdarma na všechny objednávky
  • Tisíce spokojených rodin od roku 2016
  • Snadné vrácení — 30denní bezproblémová politika vrácení
  • Bezpečné placení — vaše platební údaje jsou vždy chráněny

Spojte se s námi

Rádi vidíme sladěné rodiny! Označte nás na sociálních sítích s #DressLikeMommy a sdílejte své okamžiky.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Máte otázky? Navštivte naši stránku Kontaktujte nás — obvykle odpovídáme do jednoho pracovního dne.

Dress Like Mommy — Děláme rodinné okamžiky ještě výjimečnějšími od roku 2016.

  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

How to Start a Return

Zásady vrácení a zrušení objednávky

Ve Dress Like Mommy se zavazujeme zajistit vaši úplnou spokojenost s každým nákupem. Prosím, přečtěte si níže naše zásady vrácení a zrušení objednávky. Pokud máte jakékoli dotazy nebo potřebujete další pomoc, neváhejte nás kontaktovat na info@dresslikemommy.com.

1. Vrácení zboží

Oprávnění k vrácení

  • Lhůta: Vrácení jsou přijímána do 30 dnů od data nákupu.
  • Stav: Položky musí být vráceny v původním stavu, nenosené, nevyprané a se všemi připevněnými štítky.
  • Balení: Původní balení musí být neporušené a všechny původní součásti musí být zahrnuty.

Nevhodné pro vrácení

  • Položky, které jsou poškozené, použité, upravené nebo chybí části.
  • Vrácení bez původních objednávkových informací uvnitř balíčku.

Náklady na zpětné zaslání

  • Odpovědnost: Kupující hradí všechny náklady na zpětné zaslání.
  • Doporučení: Použijte zabezpečený nebo sledovatelný způsob dopravy a uchovejte si doklad o odeslání.

Refundace

  • Plné refundace: Jsou vydány za položky vrácené v původním stavu a balení.
  • Částečné refundace: Mohou být odečteny, pokud jsou položky vráceny poškozené, použité nebo neúplné, aby pokryly ztrátu hodnoty.
  • Doba zpracování: Refundace jsou obvykle zpracovány do 4-6 týdnů od obdržení vráceného balíčku. Často jsou však zpracovány rychleji.
  • Ověření: Refundace nebude provedena, dokud neobdržíme vrácené zboží nebo platný doklad o odeslání (např. naskenovaný doklad s datem, časem a číslem zásilky).

2. Zrušení objednávky

Zásady zrušení objednávky

  • Oprávnění: Objednávky lze zrušit do 12 pracovních hodin od zaplacení.
  • Postup: Pro zrušení objednávky nás prosím neprodleně kontaktujte na info@dresslikemommy.com v uvedené lhůtě.
  • Po odeslání: Jakmile je objednávka zabalená a odeslaná, zrušení již není možné.

3. Jak vrátit nebo vyměnit zboží

Proces vrácení nevhodných nebo nechtěných výrobků

  1. Kontaktujte nás: Napište e-mail na info@dresslikemommy.com a zahajte vrácení do 30 dnů od nákupu.
  2. Připravte balíček: Zabalte výrobek zpět do originálního obalu, ujistěte se, že všechny štítky a visačky jsou připevněné.
  3. Odeslání výrobku: Zašlete balíček na uvedenou adresu pro vrácení pomocí zabezpečené nebo sledovatelné přepravy. Doporučujeme využít místní poštu pro snížení nákladů. Uchovejte si doklad o odeslání.
  4. Potvrzení: Jakmile obdržíme vaše vrácení, zpracujeme vaši refundaci nebo výměnu a informujeme vás e-mailem.

Pravidla výměny

  • Výměny jsou možné pouze: pouze velikosti a barvy stejného výrobku lze vyměnit.
  • Jiné modely: Pro výměnu za jiný model vraťte původní výrobek a objednejte si nový požadovaný produkt.

4. Vrácení vadných výrobků

Pokud obdržíte vadný výrobek, postupujte podle těchto kroků:

  1. Kontaktujte podporu: Napište e-mail na info@dresslikemommy.com s následujícími informacemi:
    • Číslo objednávky
    • Vaše jméno a adresa
    • Detaily produktu (množství, SKU)
    • Popis problému
  2. Přiložte důkaz: Do e-mailu přiložte jasnou fotografii vadného výrobku.
  3. Pokyny k vrácení: Náš tým podpory vám poskytne pokyny, jak vrátit vadný výrobek pro vrácení peněz nebo výměnu.

5. Další informace

  • Zpracování zahrnuje: Období vrácení zahrnuje dobu přepravy, zpracování vrácení a zpracování refundace.
  • Kontaktujte nás: Pro jakékoli dotazy nebo pomoc s vrácením a zrušením objednávky nás prosím kontaktujte na info@dresslikemommy.com.

6. Položky, které nelze vrátit

  • Personalizované nebo zakázkové produkty
  • Spodní prádlo
  • Dárkové karty

7. Práva zákazníka

Pokud jste rezidentem Evropské unie, máte právo vrátit svůj nákup do 14 dnů bez udání důvodu. Pro více informací kontaktujte náš tým podpory.

Děkujeme, že nakupujete u Dress Like Mommy. Vážíme si vaší důvěry a snažíme se vám poskytnout co nejlepší nákupní zážitek.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

translations.value:
O nás

A. Obecné otázky

1. Je tato stránka bezpečná k použití?

Ano, je to bezpečné. Pro zpracování plateb používáme PayPal, takže ani náš personál nevidí vaše platební údaje. PayPal je největší světový poskytovatel bezpečných plateb. Naše webová stránka je postavena na zabezpečené platformě Shopify. Všechny vaše osobní údaje jsou pečlivě chráněny.

 

2. Jak rychle odpovídáte na e-mailové dotazy?

Na všechny e-maily odpovídáme do jednoho pracovního dne.

 

3. Kde máte sídlo?

Naše hlavní operace probíhají v Evropské unii, doplněné naším zákaznickým centrem v Litvě a výrobci a sklady ve Východní Asii.

 

4. Proč jste tak levní?

Vynecháváme všechny prostředníky a dodáváme produkty přímo od výrobců zákazníkům, což nám umožňuje nabízet extrémně nízké ceny.

Před zadáním objednávky

A. Velikosti

1. Kde najdu tabulku velikostí v centimetrech?

Použijte tabulku velikostí pro konkrétní výrobek a velikost, o které uvažujete. Zkontrolujte jednotky a zda tabulka uvádí tělesné míry, nebo rozměry oděvu. Náš průvodce velikostmi vysvětluje, jak se změřit a porovnat velikosti. Pokud je tabulka nebo některý rozměr nejasný, kontaktujte nás před objednáním.

 

2. Dostanu zboží o dvě velikosti větší?

Označení velikostí a rozměry se liší podle výrobku a výrobce. Každý kus vybírejte podle jeho vlastní tabulky velikostí a dostupných možností. Nepředpokládejte, že vám bude odpovídat vaše obvyklá velikost označená písmenem, ani nepoužívejte pevný převod velikostí. Pokud si nejste jisti, kontaktujte nás před objednáním.

B. Platby

1. Jaké typy plateb přijímáte?

Přijímáme PayPal a kreditní/debetní karty (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Chci platit kreditní kartou, ale jsem přesměrován na stránku PayPal?

Pro zpracování plateb používáme PayPal. Na stránce PayPal vpravo si můžete vybrat ze dvou možností: „Zaplatit pomocí mého PayPal účtu“ nebo „Zaplatit kreditní nebo debetní kartou“

C. Doprava

1. Jaká je cena dopravy?

Nabízíme zcela ZDARMA doručení po celém světě.

 

2. Doručujete do mé země?

Ano, doručujeme do všech zemí světa.

 

3. Jak dlouho potrvá, než obdržím svou objednávku?

Doručení obvykle trvá asi 15–30 dní. Přesné odhady doručení si však můžete zkontrolovat zde: Stránka dopravy

 

4. Musím platit clo?

Ne, clo platit nemusíte. Všechny naše objednávky označujeme jako dárky s nízkou hodnotou. Navíc větší objednávky zasíláme v samostatných balíčcích.

Po zadání objednávky

A. Stav objednávky

1. Co znamená stav objednávky „Nevyřízeno“?

Vaše objednávka je zpracovávána a sledovací číslo objednávky je v čekání. Obvykle objednávky vyřizujeme a zasíláme zákazníkům sledovací číslo, když je sledovací číslo odesláno do poštovního systému, což trvá 5-7 dní po odeslání objednávky.

 

2. Co znamená stav objednávky „Vyřízeno“?

To znamená, že vaše objednávka je na cestě.

 

3. Už to trvá příliš dlouho, kde je moje objednávka?

Prosím zkontrolujte sledování vaší objednávky pro více informací. Pokud problém přetrvává, napište nám e-mail: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Sledování objednávky

1. Jak mohu sledovat svou objednávku?

Sledovací kód objednávky poskytujeme 5-7 dní po zadání objednávky. Svoji objednávku můžete sledovat zde: Sledovat objednávku

 

2. Můj sledovací kód říká „čeká se“ nebo „momentálně nejsou dostupné žádné informace“.

Někdy se první výsledky sledování objeví 5-10 pracovních dnů poté, co obdržíte sledovací číslo objednávky. Pokud problém přetrvává déle než 10 pracovních dnů, kontaktujte nás: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Můj sledovací kód říká „expirated“

Prosím kontaktujte nás: support@dresslikemommy.com a rychle tento problém vyřešíme.

 

4. Jak zůstat informován o sledování mé objednávky?

Používáme sledovací systém After Ship k sledování objednávek našich zákazníků, takže kdykoli jsou informace o sledování aktualizovány, měli byste obdržet e-mail.

B. Chci změnit nebo zrušit svou objednávku

1. Objednal jsem něco, ale chci objednávku zrušit

Musíte nás kontaktovat do 1 pracovního dne od zadání objednávky, abyste domluvili změnu objednávky. Můžete tak učinit zasláním e-mailu na support@dresslikemommy.com s číslem vaší objednávky v předmětu.

 

2. Objednal jsem něco, ale chci změnit barvu nebo velikost zboží.

Musíte nás kontaktovat do 1 pracovního dne od zadání objednávky, abyste domluvili změnu objednávky. Můžete tak učinit zasláním e-mailu na support@dresslikemommy.com s vaší novou volbou barvy nebo velikosti.

 

3. Objednal jsem něco, ale chci změnit doručovací adresu

Musíte nás kontaktovat do 1 pracovního dne od zadání objednávky, abyste domluvili změnu objednávky. Můžete tak učinit zasláním e-mailu na support@dresslikemommy.com s vaší novou doručovací adresou.

Po obdržení objednávky

A. Chci změnit nebo vrátit svou objednávku

1. Moje objednávka dorazila, ale zboží bylo o dvě velikosti větší

Označení velikostí se může lišit. Pokud se zdá, že velikost nebo rozměry neodpovídají vaší objednávce, kontaktujte support@dresslikemommy.com a uveďte číslo objednávky a podrobnosti. Před odesláním zboží zpět si přečtěte naše aktuální podmínky vrácení peněz.

 

2. Moje objednávka dorazila, ale obdržel jsem špatné zboží

Prosím kontaktujte nás na support@dresslikemommy.com a poskytněte nám číslo vaší objednávky. Pokud je chyba na naší straně, můžete nám zboží zaslat zpět a my vám zašleme správné zboží na naše náklady (nebo vrátíme peníze).

 

3. Moje objednávka dorazila a chci změnit velikost/barvu

Prosím kontaktujte nás na support@dresslikemommy.com a poskytněte nám číslo vaší objednávky. Můžete nám zboží zaslat zpět a my vám zašleme nové zboží s aktualizovanou velikostí. *Náklady na poštovné hradíte vy.

 

4. Moje objednávka dorazila, ale chci ji vrátit.

Prosím kontaktujte nás na support@dresslikemommy.com a poskytněte nám číslo vaší objednávky. Můžete nám zboží zaslat zpět a my vám vrátíme peníze. *Náklady na poštovné hradíte vy.

Shipping Information

At Dress Like Mommy, we are an online store that ships matching family outfits to destinations available at checkout through our shipping and fulfillment partners. Here is how to confirm shipping, delivery timing, and tracking before you place an order.

Standard And Express Shipping Options

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Where We Ship

Shipping availability is based on the country/region and address entered at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can ship there under the displayed method and rate.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown, email us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Processing And Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout. Review the shipping method and estimate shown during checkout before placing your order.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, check your email for tracking information. You can also visit your account or use the tracking link in the shipping confirmation email when available.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping FAQ

Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
Contact us as soon as possible at info@dresslikemommy.com. If your order has not moved into fulfillment yet, we can review whether an address change is still possible.

Do you ship to P.O. Boxes?
Shipping availability for P.O. Boxes depends on the destination and carrier options shown at checkout.

My package has not arrived yet.
Check your tracking link first. If the tracking has not updated for several business days or the delivery estimate has passed, email us with your order number.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Last updated: January 2026

Returnering & ombytning

Vi ønsker, at du og din familie bliver glade for jeres matchende tøj! Hvis noget ikke er, som det skal være, står vi klar til at hjælpe.

Returfrist

Du har 30 dage fra leveringsdatoen til at anmode om returnering eller ombytning.

Betingelser

For at kunne returneres skal varerne være:

  • Ubrugte, uvaskede og i original stand
  • I deres originale emballage med alle mærker fastgjort
  • Fri for pletter, dyrehår, parfume eller tegn på brug

Varer, der ikke kan returneres

  • Badetøj og undertøj (af hygiejnemæssige årsager)
  • Varer markeret med "Final Sale"
  • Gavekort
  • Varer, der returneres efter 30 dage

Sådan starter du en returnering

  1. Skriv til os på info@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer og årsagen til returneringen
  2. Vores team gennemgår din anmodning og svarer inden for 1 hverdag
  3. Vi sender returinstruktioner og en returadresse
  4. Send varen eller varerne tilbage i deres originale emballage

Tilbagebetaling

Når vi har modtaget og kontrolleret din returvare:

  • Du modtager en e-mail, der bekræfter, at vi har modtaget din vare
  • Hvis returneringen godkendes, behandles tilbagebetalingen til din oprindelige betalingsmetode inden for 5–10 hverdage
  • Afhængigt af din bank kan der gå yderligere 2–5 hverdage, før beløbet vises på dit kontoudtog

Ombytning

Ønsker du en anden størrelse eller farve? Skriv til os på info@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer, så hjælper vi dig med at få den rigtige vare.

Beskadigede eller defekte varer

Har du modtaget en beskadiget eller defekt vare? Kontakt os inden for 7 dage efter levering med billeder af problemet. Vi sender en erstatningsvare eller giver fuld tilbagebetaling — du behøver ikke returnere den beskadigede vare.

Forsendelsesomkostninger

  • Kunden betaler returforsendelsen, medmindre varen ankom beskadiget eller defekt
  • De oprindelige forsendelsesomkostninger refunderes ikke

Spørgsmål?

Skriv til os på info@dresslikemommy.com, eller ring på (786) 309-6006 (man–fre, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Your privacy matters to us — this policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

We’ve written this in plain language because we believe you shouldn’t need a law degree to understand how your data is handled.

1. Who We Are

  • Legal Entity: FKG Trading LLC
  • Website: dresslikemommy.com
  • Address: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC is the data controller for all personal information collected through this website.

2. Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

When you shop with us, create an account, or get in touch, you may provide:

  • Contact information — name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Payment information — credit/debit card details (processed securely by Shopify Payments; we never see or store your full card number)
  • Account credentials — email and password if you create an account
  • Communications — messages you send us via email, contact forms, or social media
  • Order details — products purchased, sizes, quantities

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our site, certain information is collected automatically:

  • Device and browser information — browser type, operating system, screen resolution, device type
  • IP address and approximate location (city/region level)
  • Browsing activity — pages visited, products viewed, time spent on pages, referring website
  • Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 5)

Information from Third Parties

We may receive limited information from:

  • Shopify — our e-commerce platform
  • Payment processors — transaction confirmation and fraud prevention
  • Marketing platforms — if you interact with our ads

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and receipts
  • Respond to your questions and support requests
  • Improve our website, products, and shopping experience
  • Send marketing emails (only with your consent)
  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Personalize your shopping experience

We will never sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Third-Party Services

  • Shopify — powers our online store and processes orders
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — PCI-DSS compliant payment processing
  • Email marketing — newsletter delivery; unsubscribe anytime
  • Shipping carriers — deliver your order and provide tracking
  • Google Analytics — aggregated site usage data

We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

5. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to keep your cart active, remember preferences, understand traffic, and support marketing (with consent). Control cookies via your browser settings.

6. Children’s Privacy

Dress Like Mommy sells children’s clothing, but our website is not directed at children. All purchases must be made by an adult (18+). We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16 (or 13 in the US).

7. Data Retention

  • Order records — 7 years for tax/accounting
  • Account info — while active; deleted on request
  • Marketing consent — until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics — anonymized within 26 months
  • Support comms — up to 3 years after resolution

8. Your Rights

All customers can access, correct, unsubscribe from marketing, and request deletion of their data.

GDPR (EEA/UK/Switzerland): Data portability, restrict/object to processing, withdraw consent, lodge complaints.

CCPA (California): Know what we collect, delete data, opt out of sales. We do not sell your data.

Contact: info@dresslikemommy.com. Response within 30 days.

9. Data Security

SSL/TLS encryption, PCI-DSS payment processing, access controls. No method is 100% secure.

10. International Transfers

Shopify servers may be outside your country. EEA/UK/Swiss transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses.

11. Changes

We update the “Last Updated” date for significant changes.

12. Contact Us

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

Privacy Policy by FKG Trading LLC, operator of Dress Like Mommy.

Ordrer behandles inden for 1-3 hverdage efter betalingsbekræftelse. I forbindelse med helligdage, kampagner eller perioder med mange ordrer kan behandlingen tage yderligere 1-2 hverdage.

Leveringstider

Ordrer behandles inden for 1-3 hverdage efter betalingsbekræftelse. Forventede leveringstider varierer afhængigt af destination, transportør, toldbehandling og den forsendelsesmetode, der vises ved betaling.

  • Standardlevering: den aktuelle forventede leveringstid vises, inden betalingen gennemføres.

Dette er estimater. De faktiske leveringstider kan variere på grund af toldbehandling, forsinkelser hos transportøren, vejr, helligdage eller lokale forhold.

Sådan foregår vores forsendelse

  1. Ordren afgives: du modtager en ordrebekræftelse pr. e-mail.
  2. Ordren behandles: din ordre klargøres efter betalingsbekræftelse.
  3. Afsendt: sporingsoplysninger sendes pr. e-mail, når de er tilgængelige.
  4. Undervejs: brug sporingslinket til at se opdateringer fra transportøren.
  5. Leveret: din pakke leveres til den adresse, der blev angivet ved betaling.

Ordresporing

Alle ordrer omfatter et sporingsnummer, når transportøren stiller et til rådighed. Det kan tage 24-48 timer, før sporingen opdateres, efter at nummeret er udstedt.

Vi kan ikke forudsige disse omkostninger, markere ordrer som gaver eller sænke en ordres deklarerede værdi. Kontakt dit lokale toldkontor for vejledning om din destination, før du bestiller.

Problemer med forsendelsen

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

Vores Historie

Hvor Familie Mode Møder Ægte Forbindelse

Dress Like Mommy blev født ud fra en enkel idé: familier, der matcher sammen, knytter bånd sammen.

Grundlagt i 2016 af Francisco, en far til to piger i Naples, Florida, startede Dress Like Mommy, da han lagde mærke til, hvordan hans døtre lyste op hver gang, de matchede tøj med deres mor. Den glædesgnist — latteren, billederne, de "vi er tvillinger!"-øjeblikke — blev kernen i en virksomhed dedikeret til at bringe familier tættere sammen gennem mode.

Hvad Vi Gør

Vi sammensætter matchende outfits til mødre, fædre og børn — fra hyggelige feriepijamas til hverdags-casual sæt og looks til særlige lejligheder. Hvert stykke er udvalgt med komfort, stil og overkommelighed for øje, så familier overalt kan skabe de perfekte øjeblikke uden at sprænge budgettet.

Vores Kunder

Siden 2016 har vi betjent tusindvis af familier i USA, Canada, Storbritannien og Australien. Uanset om det er julemorgen med matchende nattøj, en familiefotosession eller bare en sjov dag ude med matchende tøj med din mini-me, vender vores kunder tilbage for de smil, disse outfits skaber.

Kvalitet & Omsorg

Hver vare i vores kollektion gennemgår en omhyggelig udvælgelsesproces. Vi samarbejder med pålidelige producenter for at tilbyde de nyeste matchende familiestile til fair priser. Hvis noget ikke er som det skal være med din ordre, står vores kundeserviceteam klar til at hjælpe.

Hvorfor Handle Hos Os?

  • Familieejet Virksomhed — Drevet af en ægte far, der forstår det
  • Gratis Fragt på alle ordrer
  • Tusindvis af Glade Familier siden 2016
  • Nem Returnering — 30 dages problemfri returret
  • Sikker Betaling — Dine betalingsoplysninger er altid beskyttet

Kontakt Os

Vi elsker at se familier matche! Tag os på sociale medier med #DressLikeMommy og del dine øjeblikke.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Har du spørgsmål? Besøg vores Kontakt Os-side — vi svarer typisk inden for en arbejdsdag.

Dress Like Mommy — Gør familiens øjeblikke endnu mere specielle siden 2016.
